title: illuminant-utility
body:
# what it work
This packet is intended to allow players to bring their own lighting when exploring. This makes it possible to have better visibility and discover the terrain and mobs currently being explored.

This feature is also available in Shadow Mod, you have ever used.

# How to use:
Hold the light in hand and explore.

# showcase:
[https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1eGWVe1EXk/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&vd_source=320d09e0dbdc40aba5b44c97f8185ca4](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1eGWVe1EXk/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&vd_source=320d09e0dbdc40aba5b44c97f8185ca4)

The following light sources are available：
1. torch
1. redstone torch
1. lantern
1. campfire
1. soul torch
1. lava bucket
1. glowstone
1. crying obsidian
......
